title: Quickly Baked German Apple Strudel
description: A crowd-pleasing German dessert featuring apples, ice cream, and puff pastry, perfect for any occasion. This herbal and shaggy treat is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg, and mix until the apples are evenly coated.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Arrange the apple mixture along the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border on either side.
Fold the pastry over the apples, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little bit of water, and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the strudel for 35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the strudel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving with vanilla ice cream.
